basis: PROPOSED DRAFT, not wired into anything. Power purchase agreements and similar dedicated supply deals (utility-built generation under an electric service agreement, development/funding agreements with energy rights, LOIs/MOUs/options) for config/capacity.json companies, announced 2024-01-01 or later, >= 100 MW per deal or named facility, tied to data-center/AI load or dedicated firm power. Each quote is an exact substring of its evidence file (whitespace-normalized) and contains the MW figure. 'status' says whether it is a signed agreement or an MOU, LOI or option; 'instrument' says whether a signed agreement is actually a PPA. 'mw_basis': contracted = the buyer's stated volume; nameplate = plant or project capacity where the buyer's share is not stated.

deals.facility: Uprates at Perry, Davis-Besse and Beaver Valley (213 + 80 + 140 MW)

source.title: Meta Announces Nuclear Energy Projects, Unlocking Up to 6.6 GW to Power American Leadership in AI Innovation

deals.quote: Through additional 20-year nuclear energy agreements, we will purchase more than 2.1 GW of energy from two operating Vistra nuclear power plants in Ohio (Perry and Davis-Besse), in addition to the energy from expansions (uprates) at these two Ohio plants and a third Vistra nuclear plant in Pennsylvania (Beaver Valley). All three plants are located in and will continue to deliver power into the PJM grid region, and these expansions will be the largest nuclear uprates supported by a corporate customer in the US. Meta’s commitments ensure that these facilities can continue providing reliable power to the regional electricity grid. The new additional uprate capacity at each of them, totaling 433 MW, is expected to come online in the early 2030s
deals.note: Per-plant split (213/80/140 MW) and delivery dates in the Vistra 8-K evidence file; Beaver Valley's 140 MW share alone is above 100 MW.

source.title: Google and Kairos Power Partner to Deploy 500 MW of Clean Electricity Generation

deals.quote: Kairos Power and Google have signed a Master Plant Development Agreement, creating a path to deploy a U.S. fleet of advanced nuclear power projects totaling 500 MW by 2035. In addition to Google 's 25-year agreement to purchase carbon-free nuclear energy from the Duane Arnold plant, one of the plant's current minority owners, Central Iowa Power Cooperative (CIPCO), will purchase the remaining portion of the plant's output on the same terms as Google .

source.title: How we're working with utilities to create a new model for clean energy

deals.quote: NV Energy is the first utility to operationalize this new approach through a first-of-its-kind energy supply agreement with Google. Together, we assessed solutions to bring clean capacity to the local grid and landed on enhanced geothermal. NV Energy then worked with developer Fervo Energy to include 115 MW of new, enhanced geothermal power in our CTT partnership and deliver its full capacity value to Google.

deals.facility: Three advanced nuclear sites (undisclosed)

source.title: Google and Elementl Power are collaborating to advance nuclear energy site development.

deals.quote: Google will provide early-stage capital to help Elementl prepare three potential sites in the U.S. for advanced nuclear projects, each aiming for at least 600 MW of capacity. This agreement is part of our continued work to source 24/7 baseload energy to support our operations and strengthen power grids. It also helps Elementl advance its goal of bringing significant nuclear capacity online by 2035. This innovative approach links capital investment directly with the growing demand for clean baseload power, with Google having the option for commercial off-take once projects are complete.
deals.note: Each of 3 sites targets at least 600 MW, so 1,800 MW across all three (counted that way in report totals).
